entities.name: University of al-Qarawiyyin
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Founded in 859 CE in Fez, Morocco by Fatima al-Fihri, al-Qarawiyyin is recognized by UNESCO and the Guinness World Records as the oldest existing, continually operating educational institution in the world. It began as a mosque and madrasa, evolving into a full university teaching theology, law, grammar, medicine, mathematics, and astronomy.
